title: Umphefumulo Omnene Phakathi KwabaProfethi
intro: Izwi elibiza ukulunga lizwakala emavesini e-Quran Engcwele. Lo mphefumulo obusisiwe wanikezwa isiprofetho kanye nemibhalo engcwele ngesikhathi lapho isiqondiso sasidingeka kakhulu phakathi kwabantwana bakwa-Israyeli. Lo muntu wakhuluma ngqo nabantu bakhe, ebanxusa ukuba bakhumbule iNkosi yabo. Ngokubekezela nokuzinikela, baba yisibani sokukhanya esikhanyisa amakhasi emibhalo engcwele. Ungamthola lo muntu ophawulekayo ogama lakhe lihlonishwa kokubili ku-Quran naseVangelini?
clues: Ngadunyiswa ngobuprofethi kanye nencwadi yasezulwini ngesikhathi sokuswela kwabantu bakithi.
Umama wangizala ngendlela emangalisayo, ngomyalo kaNkulunkulu kuphela.
Ngakhuluma nabantu bami, ngathi, 'O Bantwana bakwa-Israyeli! Ngiyisithunywa sika-Allah kini, esiqinisekisa lokho okwafika ngaphambi kwami.'
Ngize nezibonakaliso ezicacile ezivela eNkosini yakho, ngilethela izindaba ezinhle zomprofethi ogama lakhe lingu-Ahmad.
Umama wayengowesifazane olungile owanginikela enkonzweni ka-Allah kusukela ebusheni bami.
U-Allah wangifundisa i-Quran futhi wangenza ngaba nesihawu futhi ngaba nenhlonipho kumama, futhi ngangingazikhukhumezi noma ngingalaleli.
arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ يَـٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيْكُم مُّصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَىَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَمُبَشِّرًۢا بِرَسُولٍۢ يَأْتِى مِنۢ بَعْدِى ٱسْمُهُۥٓ أَحْمَدُ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verse: And [mention] when Jesus, the son of Mary, said, "O Children of Israel, indeed I am the messenger of Allāh to you confirming what came before me of the Torah and bringing good tidings of a messenger to come after me, whose name is Aḥmad." But when he came to them with clear evidences, they said, "This is obvious magic." (61:6)
